role: WindowSelector extension that scans a beat range with a sliding grid and evaluates each candidate window into a ScoredRecoveryBlock (artifact gate, >=50 valid RR, ectopic gate, masked RMSSD, HR CV, DFA a1, relative position).
types: WindowSelector.ScanGrid: struct — band start/end, window and step size
WindowSelector.WindowSlice: struct — bounds-checked points/flags of one window
WindowSelector.CleanBeats: struct — ectopic-filtered RRs and masked RMSSD
WindowSelector.WindowMetrics: struct (private) — meanHR, hrCV, rmssd, sdnn

units.does: Walks the grid from bandStart+windowSize to bandEnd in stepSize increments, evaluating [scanIdx-windowSize, scanIdx) each time and collecting non-nil ScoredRecoveryBlocks.

branches.effect: evaluate another window and advance by stepSize; else stop and return collected windows (none if band shorter than window)
append it; else skip silently

units.does: Evaluates one window: bounds-checked slice, valid non-artifact RR extraction (beats past the flags array count as unverified, against the window), artifact-rate gate (override or config.maxArtifactRate 0.15), >=50 valid RR, recording-break detection, ectopic gate, then builds the scored block; nil at any failed gate.

branches.effect: return nil
use config.maxArtifactRate (0.15); else the caller's limit
return nil (logged)
log and return nil

branches.cond: cleanBeats returns nil (too few beats survive ectopic gate)
branches.effect: return nil; else build scoredBlock

units.does: Returns the window's points and flags, rejecting invalid index bounds and clamping the flags slice when the flags array is shorter than points (recovered sessions).

branches.cond: startIdx >= 0, endIdx > startIdx and endIdx <= points.count
branches.effect: build slice with flags clamped to [min(startIdx,flagsUpper), min(endIdx, flags.count)); else log warning and return nil

units.does: Runs TimeDomainAnalyzer.ectopicKeepMask (the gate the reported RMSSD uses) over the window's valid RRs, requires min(minCleanBeats 300, max(50, 75% of window points)) survivors, and returns the clean RRs with masked RMSSD over adjacent kept, unbroken pairs.

branches.effect: log and return nil; else return CleanBeats

units.does: Builds the ScoredRecoveryBlock: metrics (mean HR, sample-SD SDNN — the reported estimator — and HR CV), relative position, DFA a1 when >=64 clean beats, ectopic rate, lfHfRatio always nil.

branches.effect: return nil; unreachable because evaluateWindow already required >=50 valid RR
compute DFA a1 (nil if DFAAnalyzer fails); else a1 nil, which makes isOrganizedRecovery fall back to HR CV < 8% alone
return nil; unreachable (non-empty slice guaranteed)

units.does: Collects (absolute index, rr) for beats that have a flag, are not flagged artifact, and pass HRVConstants.RRInterval.isValid. A beat past the end of the flags array (partial artifact detection on a recovered session) was never checked: it is not collected and counts with the artifacts. artifactRate = (artifact + unverified beats) / window point count.

branches.effect: iterate

branches.cond: no flag for this beat, or flagged artifact
branches.effect: count it as rejected and skip
append; else drop (not counted as artifact)

units.does: Returns false (and logs the rate, limit and the artifact-or-unverified count derived from rate × points) when the window's artifact rate exceeds the limit, else true.

branches.effect: log and return false; else return true

units.does: Computes window metrics from clean RRs: meanRR, meanHR (computeMeanHR), SDNN = Statistics.sampleStandardDeviation (divisor N-1, the estimator the reported SDNN uses), CV = SDNN/meanRR, and passes through the masked RMSSD.
Mean HR: 5-95% trimmed mean of sensor HR values when >=10 exist, plain mean of fewer, or 60000/meanRR when the window has no HR values.

branches.effect: return 60000/meanRR
return trimmed mean of the middle 90%; else plain mean

units.does: Relative position of the window midpoint within the sleep span (sessionStart..sessionEnd), 0.5 when the span is not positive.

branches.effect: return nil
return (mid - start)/duration (can be <0 or >1); else 0.5
